[!dolt] skip
# Test bd create validation failures
bd init --prefix test --quiet

! bd create
stderr 'title required'

! bd create '' --description 'still invalid'
stderr 'title required|title is required'

! bd create 'Test' --type invalid-type
stderr 'invalid issue type|unknown issue type'

! bd create 'Test' --priority 99
stderr 'priority'

! bd create 'Test' --metadata '{bad json'
stderr 'invalid JSON'
